name: Rice and grain syrup (brown rice syrup, glucose/malt syrup)

tAs.label: tAs 1000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from SG sg_foodregs_2026_other_sugars_syrups_tas_1000 (other sugars including sugar syrups). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

other_form.scope: Sugar and starch sugars (GB 2762-2025 Table 4, item 9.1); total arsenic

iAs.label: read-across from the EU 2023/915 non-parboiled milled-rice inorganic-arsenic ML (150 ug/kg): rice/grain syrup arsenic derives from the rice, and this rice-grain value is stricter and more source-appropriate than the generic sugar iAs (Israel 500). Infant-destined rice syrup escalates to the infant-rice iAs cell (100).

tHg.basis: food as listed; source unit mg/kg or mg/l

MeHg.label: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg <= tHg). No in-force sovereign sets a separate MeHg maximum level for this product on its basis, so methylmercury is governed by and bounded by the total mercury ceiling (50 ug/kg); no separate MeHg ceiling is published. The total mercury is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots MeHg is speciated whenever tHg exceeds its reflex trigger.

Ni.label: Ni 800 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from EU eu2024_ni_cereals_800 (cereals except durum/rice/husked-rice/pseudocere). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Cr.source_scope: Cereals (paddy rice calculated as brown rice, footnote a) (GB 2762-2025 Table 7, item 1.1); total Cr, not Cr-VI
Cr.label: Cr 1000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from CN china_gb2762_crtotal_grains_1000 (grains and grain products including cereals and ). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Cr-VI.label: Hexavalent chromium is a component of total chromium (Cr-VI <= Cr). No in-force sovereign sets a separate Cr-VI maximum level for this product on its basis, so hexavalent chromium is governed by and bounded by the total chromium ceiling (1000 ug/kg); no separate Cr-VI ceiling is published. The total chromium is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots Cr-VI is speciated whenever Cr exceeds its reflex trigger.

Sn.label: Sn 250000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from SG sg_foodregs_2026_any_food_sn_250000 (any food). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Al.source_scope: baked foods (bread, pastries, cakes, biscuits, cookies, crackers); deep-fried flour products; batter, breading, and frying powder
Al.basis: product as placed on market; dry sample, calculated as Al
Al.label: Al 100000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from CN cn_gb2760_2024_al_baked_foods_100000 (baked foods (bread, pastries, cakes, biscuits, c). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Rice and grain syrups are treated as sugars for Pb/Cd/tAs/tHg (strictest sovereign sugar ML). Inorganic arsenic is the load-bearing cell: brown rice syrup is a documented iAs vector (it has been used as a sweetener in infant and toddler foods), and the arsenic derives from the rice, so the cell is a disclosed read-across from the EU non-parboiled milled-rice iAs ML (150) — stricter than the generic sugar iAs (Israel 500) and source-appropriate. Rice/grain syrup DESTINED FOR infant or young-child food falls under the stricter infant-rice iAs cell (100, EU/US/UK/CA) and must be certified there instead.

warnings: rice-grain-syrup[default].tAs: informational — stricter rows exist for a different product form (PY 100 [sugars]; MERCOSUR 100 [sugars]; CN 500 [Sugar and starch sugars (GB 2762-2025 Ta])
